IBM Quantum Loon

IBM Quantum Loon

IBM · superconducting circuits · DEMONSTRATED (component testbed) (Nov 2025) · 112 physical qubits · access: lab-only
architecture: סריג טרנסמונים עם מצמדים ברי-כוונון · Open on the map

Register profile — the machine's variant of its architecture

qubit type: fixed-frequency transmon
gate mechanism: tunable couplers
connectivity: c-couplers giving up to degree 6 - a Tanner-graph connectivity testbed, not a regular lattice
control: room-temperature RF
control placement: room-temp
readout: dispersive; integrated qubit reset gadgets
flags: no published error rates

Technologies by layer — the machine's cell per layer

טרנסמון · primary ▥ Fig. (chip photos: 'IBM Quantum Loon (Credit: IBM)', 3 images); §Building our fault-tolerant architecture ✅

תת-מרחב דו-רמתי חשוף · primary ◌ 🔎
bare transmon two-level subspace; no encoding beyond the physical qubit

tunable couplers

מצמדים לטווח ארוך על השבב (מצמדי c, בסדר גודל של mm) · primary ▥ §Building our fault-tolerant architecture (6-way qubit connections; physically longer couplers; more routing layers) ✅

אלקטרוניקה בטמפרטורת החדר + קואקס/כבל גמיש לכל קיוביט · primary ▨ 🔎

איפוס קיוביט מהיר בלתי מותנה / דיסיפטיבי · primary ▥ §Building our fault-tolerant architecture (reset gadgets that quickly reset the qubit to the ground state) ✅
integrated on-chip qubit reset gadgets alongside dispersive readout (Nov 2025)
קריאה דיספרסיבית במיקרוגל (+TWPA, מסנן פרסל) · alternate ▨ 🔎
dispersive readout; integrated qubit reset gadgets
7 קוד
קודי qLDPC לא-מקומיים (bivariate-bicycle, "gross") · alternate ▥ §Building our fault-tolerant architecture (key components needed to implement our qLDPC codes) ✅

— none — nothing in this layer ▥ §Building our fault-tolerant architecture (proof-of-concept processor for qLDPC components; 'almost out of fabrication') ✅
no QEC run as of Sep 2026; component testbed proving all key processor components for fault tolerance on one die
8 מפענח
Relay-BP ל-qLDPC (FPGA) · alternate ▣ Fig. 2 (Relay-BP FPGA decoder architecture); Fig. 5 (XCVU19P floorplan); §4 🔎
not run on Loon; target Relay-BP for [[144,12,12]] on AMD VU19P FPGA, <1 µs per cycle, on stored syndromes only

9 חיבור בין-מודולי
— none — nothing in this layer ▥ §Building our fault-tolerant architecture (extra routing layers on the chip surface; longer on-chip couplers) ✅
monolithic single die, no inter-module link; long couplers cross via multi-layer routing + TSV-style vertical interconnect on-chip
10 ייצור
ליתוגרפיה של קיוביטים מוליכי-על (צמתי ג'וזפסון Nb/Al, 300 mm) · primary ▥ Fig. ('IBM researcher holding a 300mm IBM Quantum Loon wafer'); §Building our fault-tolerant architecture ✅
300 mm; multiple high-quality low-loss routing layers + TSV-style vertical interconnect so long couplers cross without interference
